procs.name: Void Reaver
procs.tooltip: Avoiding or absorbing an attack now has a $h% chance to make your next Blade of the Empire deal $502133s2% more damage and hit an additional nearby enemy and cost no mana.
procs.proc_spell_source: EffectTriggerSpell[0] of 800463; aura_ascension_cultist_event casts 502133 on caster (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:64,104,234).
procs.handler: aura_ascension_cultist_event: Check (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:64,104) accepts avoided (PROC_HIT_DODGE | PROC_HIT_PARRY | PROC_HIT_MISS) or absorbed hits and rolls Chance(player, 800463) (roll_chance_f of Spell.dbc ProcChance 20, no cooldown; spell_proc.Chance zeroed by rev_20261003_10); Proc (:234) casts 502133 on caster. Dreadnought weapon set (2534 Dagger + 2129 Shield). Ten stationary strikers (creature 36) with Self Root Forever 42716, Molten 62531 and Enrage 2116852 swing at the caster with dodge 100 and parry 0. count_misses true (ADR 1210) adds missed swings (melee_missed_taken) to dodged + parried trials with attack-balance verification, and miss_exclusion (min_share 0.04, ADR 1229) verifies the server rolls on misses too (0.20 * (1 - miss_share) must lie below the Wilson interval). Residual: parry (parry 0) and absorb arms are not separately rate-tested here. Sized for residual_target 0.001 per pair, min_detectable 4 pts (G-20 +-2 pt band on 20%). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history spell 800463 has 0 events (passive; 502133 has SPELL_AURA_REFRESH in 1 log); coabuildhub spells_master_index.json has an older version of 800463 omitting 'and cost no mana'; installed server Spell.dbc (502133 Effect[2] aura 108 -100% cost) governs.

Partner 560525 is learned up front (before_expected 0.970874 proves partner works alone, excluding 1.0), then Visions 560526 is learned between phases (expected 0.970874 proves capping, excluding both stacked 0.942596 and no-op 1.0; tolerance 0.0001 -> band [0.970774, 0.970974]). Replaces group_stack_cap which cannot set relation=inverse on cast_speed_multiplier without swings (behaviours.py:4014-4020). behaviours.name: Saronite Blessing (melee auto attacks heal lowest health ally, not full-health caster)
behaviours.quote: Melee critical strikes now apply Saronite Blessing to you.@s:600327:0@

arms.source: AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:277-280 Allies(player, player, 40, 1): full-health caster (100% after Lay on Hands 633) must NOT receive 302897 heals when grouped ally has +2040 max HP deficit (Prayer of Fortitude 48162 +115 Sta, Gift of the Wild 48470 +37 Sta, Spirit of Zandalar 24425 +25 Sta, Greater Blessing of Kings 25898 +10% stats without healing, disable_regeneration: true, 64481 -100% crit keeping ally well below 100% across all 5-7 swings)

behaviours.observe_source: Lowest-health-ally reach proof (forward arm: ally lowest) for Saronite Blessing 301262/600327 (AscensionCultistEvents.cpp:277-280): Allies(player, player, 40, 1) picks the lowest-health-pct grouped ally within 40 yd (AscensionCultist.cpp:245-249) and copies 100% of auto-attack damage into 302897 heal. Setup casts raid/area Stamina buffs Prayer of Fortitude 48162 (+115 Sta), Gift of the Wild 48470 (+37 Sta), Spirit of Zandalar 24425 (+25 Sta), and Greater Blessing of Kings 25898 (+10% stats) without healing (~+2040 max HP deficit, dropping ally near ~55% HP), then Lay on Hands 633 restores caster to 100% HP while ally stays below 100% (disable_regeneration: true); phase aura 64481 (-100% crit, precondition fixture) keeps non-crit Heretic staff 2535 swings (~215 dmg each) from ever topping off ally across 4 swing intervals (14400 ms -> 5-6 swings = ~1100-1300 total heal vs ~2040 deficit, leaving ally >15 percentage points below caster's 100% throughout so GUID tie-break cannot decide). Before phase runs 4 swing intervals without 600327 (0 heals to ally and caster); gate_cast casts real 600327 (15000 ms, 10 charges, +25% melee haste -> 2640 ms swing time); after phase delivers 5-7 heals of 302897 to ally and 0 to full-health caster (ally_arm). Paired with symmetric reverse arm caster_lowest (caster lowest via 72590+46302, ally 100%): together >=10 independent picks per run (>=20 per pair) exclude fixed/GUID-order selection deterministically and random selection with probability <= (1/2)^10 = 9.77e-4 per run (<= 9.5e-7 per pair). Paired with 301262 trigger_magnitude_ratio (100% of melee damage dealt). Reference search 2026-11-24: coa-history 302897: 1006 SPELL_HEAL events in 3 logs; coabuildhub spells_master_index.json 301262 matches verbatim.

behaviours.name: Depths of Madness (the void portal casts Gaze of C'thun)
behaviours.quote: that casts either Gaze of C'thun, Horrorbolt, or Obliteration Beam
behaviours.observe_source: Tooltip: the void portal casts either Gaze of C'thun, Horrorbolt, or Obliteration Beam. AscensionCultistSummons.cpp:290-297 picks roots[urand(0, 2)] from {500110, 800416, 805572} and the portal casts it at the dummy; Gaze of C'thun reaches the dummy through 500110 -> 520334 -> 520332, so its damage events by the portal (caster_entry 533030, spell 520332) are the read; they are cumulative over every portal of the phase (harness spell_damage_count with caster_entry, CoAGameplayTest.cpp:5359-5397). The tooltip states no share for the three spells and none is asserted: the claim is that Gaze of C'thun occurs at least once. Sizing: 180 Gaze casts per phase, each rolls the 15% portal and, for a spell with a 1/3 share, the spell is cast with probability 0.15/3 = 0.05 per cast, so a missed spell has probability 0.95^180 = 9.78e-05 per run; over 3 spells x 2 runs of a pair the bound is 6 x 0.95^180 = 5.87e-04 <= 0.1% per pair. Control: the same 180 casts before 706911 is learned produce 0 damage events of 520332 by 533030. Precondition fixture as portal_casts: caster aura 823764 (target magic resistance -9999) so every Gaze lands. The exact-one-cast-per-portal and no-other-spell properties are not read here (see the ledger tool_gap). Reference search 2026-11-25: Spell.dbc 500110 effects trigger 520334/520335, 800416 school damage, 805572 channel triggering 805573 (school damage). Gaze of C'Thun 500110 costs 15% of the mana pool (Spell.dbc ManaCostPercentage 15), so refill_power_after_setup_casts sets the mana back to cast_power after every setup cast; without it the pool of the first prove covered about 7 casts and the later casts were refused (portals dealt 0-2 hits in 180 casts).

behaviours.name: Tentacle of N'Zoth (retargets when primary runs out of range)
behaviours.quote: If your target runs out of range, the tentacle will seek a new target.
behaviours.observe_source: Spell.dbc (/srv/coa/server-data/dbc) fixes RangeIndex 11 (SpellRange[11] = 15.0 yd, Fifteen yards) on both Tentacle of N'Zoth 572103 and Thoughtseize 806596 (AttributesEx = SPELL_ATTR1_IS_CHANNELED | SPELL_ATTR1_TRACK_TARGET_IN_CHANNEL). Under owner rulings O-20 and O-22 (2026-11-25, Cultist ADRs 0034 and 0036), AscensionCultistSummons.cpp reads Thoughtseize's runtime GetMaxRange(false, me) (15.0 yd) for both dropping the current target and scanning replacement enemies on entry 501464 via IsWithinDistInMap / Nearby (recomputed effective center-to-center boundary against Harvest Golem 36: 15.0 + 0.75 [DEFAULT_COMBAT_REACH 1.5 * DisplayScale 0.5 on display 28813] + 1.275 [creature_model_info 367] = 17.025 yd) and removes Thoughtseize 806596 from the previous target on the first UpdateAI tick once out of range before seeking a replacement. Because 572103 (TARGET_DEST_TARGET_RANDOM, SpellRadius[8] = 5.0 yd, Spell.cpp:1791-1796) spawns 501464 randomly within a 5.0 yd disk around dummy, any dummy-relative move_point has +-5.0 yd placement uncertainty relative to 501464. Tests along the verified clear-LOS south (-y) axis with Sprint 11305 applied symmetrically at the tightest non-flaky bracket allowed by the 5.0 yd spawn disk: control moves dummy -10.0 yd ([5.0..15.0] yd <= 15.0 yd, area1 stays 0 and raw primary_aura stays 1), near treatment moves dummy -22.5 yd ([17.5..27.5] yd > 17.025 yd, < 40 yd, area1 receives 806596 and raw primary_aura reads 0), far treatment moves dummy -50.0 yd (> 40 yd, area1 receives 806596 and raw primary_aura reads 0), requiring primary alive == 1 and line_of_sight == true at every check (ADR 1313). Paired with retarget_short_delay, search_inside_15yd, and search_beyond_15yd. Reference search 2026-11-25: ev2.md Q-cu-32 has 3 live tentacles in 1 log (67, Hyrax, 2026-07-12) with 4 ticks per 8 s Thoughtseize and matching 15 yd tooltip, nothing found on retargeting distance or out-of-range channel break.

behaviours.quote: Damage dealt may end this effect.

arms.source: Ancient Curse 500712 (+20000 SP, ~31000 Shadow damage) lands on the feared Kobold Vermin 6 in treatment only (0 -> 1)

behaviours.observe_source: Orchestrator decision D-38 and Necromancer ADR 0082 / 800706 precedent (stock HandleBreakableCCAuraProc cumulative damage cap BaseHealth(60)/4.75 = 1048 at SpellAuraEffects.cpp:548-562,7245-7253, deterministic, no break probability asserted): both phases cast Corrupt Mind 560109 on Kobold Vermin 6 in setup_casts (setup_in_before: true) and read aura 560109 PRESENT == 1 right before the trigger via after_setup_stacks (eliminating any 0 -> 0 false pass). Control (no damage) reads 560109 == 1; treatment casts Ancient Curse 500712 (+20000 SP, ~31000 Shadow damage, confirmed landed 0 -> 1 via ally_arm) and reads 560109 == 0 (broken). Paired with damage_holds proving a smaller damaging hit (~620 Shadow damage) leaves 560109 active (1 -> 1), observing both outcomes literally asserted by 'Damage dealt may end this effect.' Reference search 2026-11-25: coa-history spell 560109 has 19 cast starts, 24 applies, 24 removals, and 13 SPELL_AURA_BROKEN_SPELL events across 4-8 logs (confirming damage breaks Corrupt Mind live); coabuildhub spells_master_index.json 560109 matches installed Spell.dbc verbatim; no pending_db_world spell_dbc or streamed description override.
